note: Edits to the OSM layout for Old Macdonald, written by make_edits.py (generic resort edits, then course_edits.json); built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py.

add.reason: 95 golf=path ways inside the boundary, not read by s01: copied as golf=cartpath (free relief, drawn as paths)

Black tee boxes where OSM maps none: 12 x 8 m boxes on the start of the OSM hole lines (developer, 2026-10-21: the tees are at the start of the lines), except holes 1 and 13, whose lines measure 16-17 % beyond the Black card from their start: there the box stands where the Black card distance falls on the line (course chat's call, an open item)

the green holes 5 and 10 share (OSM w697052065, one polygon with a pin for each hole), cut into one part per hole by split_double_greens.py (perpendicular bisector of the two OSM pins), so each hole has its own centre, pin and putting views (as at Langdon Farms)
hole 8 (Biarritz, a 69 m green): the centre pin at the green's visual centre; OSM's pin was 16 m off it, outside the close-up putting view's margin (the game adds three more pins round the green)

tags.reason: Elbow Lake (golf=water_hazard): every penalty area red (standing default)
